payload.claim: This docstring claims the test covers 'Criteria 1 to 3' (the spec's three acceptance criteria that need their own witness), but the function body only exercises acceptance criterion 1 (SIGTERM mid-IMPLEMENT, mid-REVIEW, and a bare KeyboardInterrupt). The second-SIGTERM behaviour of criterion 2 is tested separately by test_a_second_sigterm_does_not_cut_the_teardown_short, and the external-process behaviour of criterion 3 is tested separately by test_a_process_sent_sigterm_exits_143_with_its_log_flushed, both further down in this same file. A reader checking that each acceptance criterion has its own witness would be misled by this docstring into believing this single function discharges all three.
